faqData.q: How does high-pressure misting cool outdoor spaces?
faqData.a: Our system pressurizes water to 150 bar and forces it through 0.15mm ceramic nozzles, creating 5-15 micron droplets. These micro-droplets flash-evaporate in mid-air, absorbing 2,257 kJ of heat per liter of water (latent heat of vaporization). The result is an instant 5-15°C temperature reduction without wetting surfaces.

faqData.q: Will the mist wet my guests, furniture, or food?
faqData.a: No. This is the key difference between 100Cooling and conventional spray systems. Our 5-15 micron droplets evaporate completely before reaching any surface. Guests feel only the cooling effect, never moisture. This has been verified in thousands of installations across restaurants, resorts, and event venues.

faqData.q: What's the difference between high-pressure and low-pressure misting?
faqData.a: Low-pressure systems (7-20 bar) produce 50-100 micron droplets that do not fully evaporate, causing wetness. High-pressure systems (70-150 bar) produce 5-15 micron droplets that flash-evaporate completely. The cooling efficiency difference is approximately 3-5x. 100Cooling exclusively uses high-pressure technology.

faqData.q: How does the mosquito repellent system work?
faqData.a: Our peristaltic dosing pump injects measured amounts of botanical or synthetic repellent into the misting line. The same 150-bar pressure atomizes the repellent into the fine mist, creating a 6-meter high protective barrier. Scheduling is fully automated via the MG-IOT HUB. The system can operate in cooling-only or cooling+repellent modes.

faqData.q: Are the repellent chemicals safe for food service areas?
faqData.a: Yes. We offer EPA-registered botanical repellent concentrates (pyrethrin-based) that are food-safe when used as directed. Our FDA Food-Grade certification covers all materials in contact with the mist water. The system includes backflow prevention and double containment for chemical safety.

faqData.q: What is the maximum coverage area for one system?
faqData.a: Our MG-PRO 1500 pump station supports up to 200 nozzles, covering approximately 5,000 m². The MG-INDUSTRIAL system with dual redundant pumps covers up to 10,000 m². For larger areas, we design multi-zone configurations with synchronized controllers.

faqData.q: What is the typical ROI timeline?
faqData.a: Most commercial clients recover their investment in 8-18 months through: increased outdoor seating revenue (restaurants typically see 30-60% increase), reduced HVAC energy costs (90% less than equivalent AC), and extended operating seasons. Our free ROI calculator provides project-specific estimates.
